2b6(mdo): byed do//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bgrod pa gcig pu'i lam ston pa/rnam pa gnyis kyi shes bya dang /ye shes la mnga' brnyes pa/ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum la mkhas pa
